_note: The only lesson file (promoted in M7-P2; content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json is retired). lesson-move was dropped (Manager call, M7-P2): the tutorial floor's walk step teaches moving.
notes: Written for M7-P6, revised after the M7-P13 review (PR #46). Session 1 (the tutorial, run 1) teaches only Move, the '!' warning, the guided Counter and Strike. The warning and guided Counter lines, plus 'slowdown'/'nudge', are copied exactly from content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json. lesson-counter-hint-2 and -3 are fading follow-ups (fadingFollowUp: true) and don't count as new lessons. Bow is taught once, by the tutorial floor's tutorial-bow step, so there is no second Bow lesson at home (review S1). After session 1, at most one new lesson per session: Dash (2), Insights (3), Decorating (4). Great Counter, Block and Step-out have ignoresSessionLimit: true and show right away the first time they come up. Keys: id, order, trigger, screens, practice, success, retry, earliestSession, ignoresSessionLimit, fadingFollowUp, plus optional slowdown/nudge. One sentence per screen; button names match the UI. line-welcome-home is a plain greeting on the first return home, not a lesson. It has no practice room and doesn't count toward the session limit. {player} is the profile's display name. triggerKey is the event the game fires for the lesson (M7-P5, Manager call). scroll: false keeps a line off the Lesson Scroll (the fading follow-ups and line-welcome-home, Manager call). A session is a calendar day with at least one run (Manager call); earliestSession counts those days.
